title: Object Pronouns Across Varieties: Leísmo, Laísmo, and Loísmo
goal: Recognize leísmo, laísmo, and loísmo in peninsular Spanish and identify their standard lo/la/le equivalents

items: I can recognize leísmo, laísmo, and loísmo in peninsular Spanish and identify their standard lo/la/le equivalents
I can distinguish the one normatively accepted leísmo (singular male person) from non-standard leísmo of things, laísmo, and loísmo
I can maintain standard direct and indirect object pronoun usage in my own formal production
